technologies.name: Parchment
technologies.description: Unlocks parchment and allows you to create written material.
technologies.flavor: Parchment became an important carrier of information in the ancient world.

technologies.name: Mathematics
technologies.description: -10% to the work cost of construction.
technologies.flavor: Ancient civilizations could count, but only now has knowledge moved from simple recipes to strict proofs. Geometry and abstract calculation let people not just watch the world but compute it: from the shape of a wheel's teeth to the motion of the stars.

technologies.name: Calendar
technologies.flavor: People have tracked the turning of the seasons since the earliest times, but only now has the calendar become a standard tool of management: precise planning of sowing, pruning and harvest let plantations reach their full potential.

technologies.name: Draft Animals
technologies.description: Unlocks the use of draft animals to turn millstones.
technologies.flavor: Draft animals let people harness animal strength for heavy work, greatly raising output and efficiency in farming and construction.

technologies.name: Water Wheel
technologies.description: Unlocks the use of the water wheel to set millstones in motion.
technologies.flavor: The water wheel became an important source of power in the ancient world, automating the processing of grain and other materials.

technologies.name: Paper
technologies.description:
Allows you to build the paper workshop.
Allows you to produce paper from mulberry, hemp and ramie with the help of lime.
technologies.flavor: This revolutionary invention made it possible to create an affordable, practical material for writing.

technologies.name: Scriptoriums
technologies.flavor: In scriptoriums scribes copied, translated, rewrote and recensioned texts on administration, the worship of the gods, magic and the curing of disease.

technologies.name: Cartography
technologies.description: Allows scouts to explore areas in the fog of war.
technologies.flavor: The art of exploring the land and drawing maps of it.

unlock_effects.name: Allows scouts to explore areas in the fog of war.

technologies.name: Alchemy
technologies.description: Allows you to build the alchemist's house.
technologies.flavor: A protoscience of attempts to turn base metals into gold.
